levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Skips steps or does them out of the confirmed order without adjusting.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Completes all steps in the confirmed order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Completes all steps in order and catches or corrects a deviation on their own.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Attempts a supervision-required step without the adult present.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Follows every category correctly and proactively checks in before an ambiguous step.

lookFors: Adult present for the full duration of every supervision-required step, confirmed by the adult.
Every plan step is verifiably completed, not just attempted.
Reflection critiques the plan itself, not just the learner's effort.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
